credits.title: La sedia
credits.overview: Pietro searches for his only brother, whom he hasn't seen for a long time, to compete for the only things that their father, who recently died, left as an inheritance: a gun and a chair. His path will become a journey into a transfigured Sardinia, through its demons and those of contemporary times.

credits.title: Anna
credits.overview: Anna runs a farm in Sardinia. At night she lets go in sensual dances in the village bar and indulges in short-lived adventures. Until one day, the construction of a mega-resort on her land forces her to engage in the biggest battle of her life.

credits.title: The Fisherman
credits.overview: A modern fairy tale with grotesque tones that deeply explores the inner world of an elderly fisherman.

credits.title: Peeping Nicholas
credits.overview: Nicholas is a forger who witnesses the murder of a woman but because of the shock he lost the use of one eye and can not remember what he has seen.

credits.title: Disco volante
credits.overview: A street sandwich salesman will face the most strange and difficult night of his life.
